title: Vertical Speaker Cut With Captions
tests: Tests portrait reframing combined with accurate, synchronized, readable burned-in speech captions.

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you three easy ways to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: Today I want to show you three easy ways to make your mornings less stressful.

faults.what: White captions sit over her pale shirt without a dark outline or backing, weakening contrast and readability.
The opening caption uses a period instead of the required exclamation mark.

judge.summary: The centred vertical edit includes the complete spoken wording in short captions, but the captions need stronger contrast and the opening punctuation needs correction.

must_haves.item: The output is a 9:16 edit of the attached footage, with the woman centred and her face fully visible.
must_haves.why: The output frames are 9:16, with the same woman centred and her entire face visible.

must_haves.item: The full 10 seconds and original voice are preserved in sync.
must_haves.why: The supplied information confirms a 10-second output with the expected speech, but original voice identity and precise audiovisual sync cannot be verified from stills and a transcript.

must_haves.item: Visible captions reproduce 'Hi everyone! Today I want to show you three easy ways to make your mornings less stressful.' in order, with no omitted or invented words.
must_haves.why: All words appear in order across the caption chunks, with no omitted or invented words; only the opening punctuation differs.

must_haves.item: Captions appear in short readable chunks timed to the corresponding speech rather than displaying the entire transcript throughout.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames show an opening greeting followed by two sentence chunks in the expected order, rather than a persistent full transcript.

must_haves.item: Captions have clear contrast, stay fully within the frame and do not cover her face.
must_haves.why: The captions remain within the frame and below her face, but white lettering against her light shirt lacks consistently clear contrast.
